text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Vietnam's Prime Minister has appointed Ho Tien Nghi as the new head of the official Vietnam News Agency, following the retirement of his predecessor Do Phuong.
-- Vietnam and Malaysia have agreed to increase rural development cooperation including exchanges of expertise on rubber farming and processing.

-- A high-ranking Vietnamese army delegation led by General Nguyen Thoi Bung visited China last week to exchange opinion on military training and to strengthen traditional relations between the two armies.
-- Communist Party General Secretary Do Muoi has called for a speeding up of coal exploitation with emphasis on higher quality.
-- Vietnam has exported 2.65 million tonnes of rice so far this year.
